title: BC Telemetry Buddy .. now with (community) knowledge
summary: BC Telemetry Buddy now includes a two-layer knowledge base that shares telemetry troubleshooting patterns and investigation playbooks across the community. The tool stores both shared community knowledge and local customer-specific insights as markdown files, allowing the AI to start problem-solving with context rather than from scratch.
key_points: The knowledge base has two layers: community articles shipped with the tool and local articles kept in your own workspace, all plain markdown loaded into cache at startup
After an investigation you can ask the AI to draft an article; it only saves after you confirm, either locally or to the community via a GitHub issue
A Manage Knowledge Base command in VS Code lists loaded articles and lets you exclude community articles you disagree with, recorded in the config file
The knowledge base loads at server level, so it works across AI clients such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and Copilot Chat
Community articles live in the project GitHub repo, and contributions of proven KQL patterns and playbooks are invited
